name: gold-bridge
description: Bridge web service between the DayZ Robinhood server and the $GOLD ERC-20 on Robinhood Chain

scripts.build: npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/db.js && node --check src/chain.js && node --check src/middleware.js
